clips.title: The story
paras: Fire Taboo is a task assigned by Rethiel the Greenwarden along the marshy roads of the Wetlands. Tormented by the suffering of the local forest, the bog beast sends travelers to strip the Mosshide gnolls of the crude flints they use to ignite and burn living wood. By depriving the gnolls of fire, Rethiel hopes to spare the bog's ancient boughs from being consumed.

Rethiel the Greenwarden watches over the wilds of the Wetlands, maintaining a profound spiritual kinship with the trees of the marsh. While the natural cycle of rot and renewal belongs in a swamp, the deliberate destruction of the timber cuts deep into Rethiel's spirit. To a living spirit of the marsh, hearing the groans of living boughs chopped down and cast into hearthfires is an agony Rethiel can no longer endure in silence.

The Mosshide pack ravages the wetlands for warmth and territory, felling green trees rather than gathering fallen deadwood. To curb their expansion without a prolonged war of attrition, Rethiel targets the key tool of their destruction: the crude flints used by the stronger gnolls. By stripping the pack of fire-making implements, Rethiel renders them unable to burn the felled timber. Rethiel personally shatters each collected stone and casts the dust into the sea, ensuring those sparks will never ignite the forest again.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Mosshides are cutting the trees of the Wetlands, using the trees' flesh to warm themselves with fire. I will suffer this pain no longer!
Rid the Mosshides of their crude flints, the tools they use to make fire. The flints are borne by all Mosshides except the smaller Mosshide gnolls and Mosshide mongrels.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?

clips.title: Completion
paras: ... Thank you. I will smash these flints and cast them into the sea, so that they may never again be used to burn living wood.
